image_description: A large, dark brown bison standing in a grassy field, viewed from the side. The animal has a massive shoulder hump covered in thick, shaggy fur, while the hindquarters appear smoother and less furred. Its head is lowered towards the ground, likely grazing. One short, curved horn is visible on the right side of its head. The legs are sturdy but partially obscured by tall green grass.

The bison's head is angled down and the eye region is shadowed/obscured by fur and angle, making it impossible to verify eye color or presence clearly.
Ears are not distinctly visible; they are either hidden in the thick mane/fur or obscured by the camera angle.
